children: Aditya Birla Lifestyle reported its results for Q2FY27 on Thursday, October 31. The retailer improved its figures from FY26, reporting an increase in profit and revenue.

The Mumbai-based retailer reported a net profit of ₹53 crore for the quarter that ended in September, higher than the previous year's ₹23 crore (YoY). When it comes to its topline figure, the company's revenue for Q2 came in at ₹2,266 crore, compared to ₹2,038 crore last year, marking a 11.2% rise.

When it comes to its operational profitability, the company reported Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortisation, or EBITDA, up 13.8% from the previous year, as it posted EBITDA of ₹360 crore, compared to ₹317 crore in the previous year. Finally, the company reported a margin of 15.9%, marginally higher than 15.5% in Q2FY26.

Delving deeper into the company's business, the Lifestyle Brands business grew revenue 9% to ₹1,906 crore from ₹1,754 crore. Its EBITDA rose to ₹371 crore from ₹338 crore, and its margin edged up to 19.5% from 19.3%.

Meanwhile, the Emerging Business segment grew faster, with revenue up 27% to ₹371 crore from ₹292 crore. Its EBITDA jumped to ₹25 crore from ₹4 crore, lifting its margin to 6.8% from 1.5%. Inter-segment eliminations were ₹11 crore on revenue, against ₹8 crore last year, and ₹6 crore on EBITDA, against ₹5 crore.

In terms of channels of revenue, retail, the largest channel, grew 8% to ₹1,209 crore from ₹1,123 crore. Wholesale was the fastest-growing channel, up 18% to ₹597 crore from ₹506 crore. E-commerce rose 12% to ₹360 crore from ₹322 crore, and other channels grew 15% to ₹99 crore from ₹86 crore.

Furthermore, as of September 2026, the company operates 3,434 brand stores across more than 800 cities and towns. This includes over 560 stores in small towns and a presence in more than 190 malls. The company’s retail footprint stands at 5.1 million sq ft.

When we look at the performance of the company's stock, it fell nearly 1% on Friday's trade, taking it closer to ₹70 per share. The stock has fallen over 30% in the past 6 months, and over 44% in this year's trade.

title: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Q2 result: Revenue rises; wholesale channel grows 18%
